meta.source: Authored for SignBridge Phase 1 from published one-handed manual alphabet references. Numerals are an ASL-style reference set.
meta.notes: DRAFT DATA. Every handshape must be reviewed by a fluent deaf ISL signer before it is marked supported (see docs/sign-format.md). Numerals: ISL handshapes for 6-9 differ from the reference set used here and must be replaced after review.

signs.handshape: Closed fist with the thumb resting upright against the side of the index finger
signs.movement: Static hold with a small settle
signs.palmOrientation: Palm faces inward, toward the body

signs.handshape: Flat hand, four fingers straight and together, thumb folded across the palm
Hand curved into a C: fingers and thumb rounded, a clear gap between them
signs.palmOrientation: Palm facing the signer's left (profile view) so the C curve is visible

signs.handshape: Index finger up; middle, ring and little fingers curled to meet the thumb
Fingers bent at the knuckles with the tips resting on the thumb
Index finger and thumb form a circle; other three fingers extended
Index finger and thumb extended parallel, pointing forward and slightly down
Index and middle fingers extended together, pointing sideways
Little finger extended upward from a closed fist
Little finger extended (the I handshape) tracing a J in the air
signs.movement: The little finger draws a J: down, then hooks to the left

signs.handshape: Index and middle fingers up in a V, thumb forward between them
Index finger up and thumb out to the side, forming an L
Three fingers folded over the thumb tucked beneath them
signs.notes: Thumb tucked under the fingers. In 2D the thumb sits behind the curled fingers, so M/N/A/S/T read very similarly — flagged for signer review.

signs.handshape: Two fingers folded over the thumb tucked beneath them
signs.notes: Thumb tucked under the fingers. In 2D the thumb sits behind the curled fingers, so M/N/A/S/T read very similarly — flagged for signer review.

signs.handshape: Fingers and thumb curved to form a closed O
signs.palmOrientation: Palm facing the signer's left (profile view) so the O is visible

signs.handshape: The K handshape rotated so the fingers point down
The G handshape rotated so index and thumb point down
Index and middle fingers crossed
Closed fist with the thumb laid across the front of the fingers
Fist with the thumb pushed up between the index and middle fingers
Index and middle fingers up, held together
Index and middle fingers up and spread apart
Index, middle and ring fingers up and spread
Index finger hooked, the rest closed
Thumb and little finger extended, other fingers closed
Index finger extended, tracing a Z in the air
signs.movement: The index finger draws a Z: across, diagonally back, then across again

signs.handshape: Closed O handshape
